params.body:
Four things Shane saw on the photo tab of the vehicle sheet on 15 September 2026, one PR, all on top of PR 401 (two sets, toolbars first, the ⋯ sheet).

## 1. A quiet notice about missing platform copies

"dit staat wat vet, en link hangt er wat aangeplakt." The warning inherited the red bold processing style and glued its action to the sentence as an underlined link. Now `ui-photo-notice`: regular weight in the body ink, a 3 px amber groove on the left, a pale ground, the sentence in its own paragraph and the action as a small `ui-button` next to it (under it on a phone) reading "Platformkopieën aanmaken (20)" (singular for one). Same handler as the link had (one POST, `ui.notify`, gallery refresh), and after the refresh the notice follows the copies it queued (see 2). `ui-processing-note--warn` is gone.

## 2. Copy progress that follows the queue

"copying animation is a bit ugly." Every target tile became an empty grey box with a ring. Worse: the request only dispatches a `ProcessImage` job. On staging the seal forces `sync` so it looked instant; on production today twenty jobs sat in `jobs` for minutes (worker paused by maintenance mode) and twenty tiles spun with no end and no way to tell.

- The tile keeps its photo, dimmed (opacity .5, less saturation), with a small pill in the middle: "Kopie maken…" on a platform copy, "Verwerken…" on an own photo. A copy in the making shows the own photo it is made from (its own file does not exist yet, `media_version` is still null); a copy being redone shows itself.
- The poll (`polling.js`, `ownvehicle.index.polling`) runs at once and then every five seconds, swaps a finished tile in with a soft fade, and dispatches `photos-polled` on the document. The response now also names `queued`: the asked photos whose job sits in `jobs` without `reserved_at` (`App\Support\PhotoQueue` reads the photo id from the serialized command). Those pills say "In wachtrij…".
- One progress line above the grid while a series runs: "3 van 8 kopieën klaar" with a groove that fills, measured against the tiles still in processing (a deleted tile counts as handled, so the series always ends); it goes away four seconds after the last one. The own grid gets the same line for "Achtergrond verwijderen", the platform grid for "Blur weghalen".
- Three minutes without movement: the pill turns amber, "Verwerking duurt langer dan verwacht", no ring, the photo stays; the line says it too.
- A request that itself fails puts a small red "Niet gelukt" chip on the unchanged photo instead of leaving it grey; the existing `PhotoFailure` reason uses the same chip. Retry is the same action again.
- A series already running when the page loads is followed from the start. The create sheet now always loads the poller (it was behind `@if($polling)`, so a series on a sheet that loaded without processing was never followed).
- Reduced motion: the ring stands still, the fade is off.

Nothing changed in what the server does with a photo; only what the tab shows, and one extra field in the poll response.

## 3. Drag to reorder works again

"we moeten volgorde foto's aanpassen door te slepen." Two causes, both from this week: since the lightbox (PR 330) the whole photo is a link, and our sortable refuses to start a drag on a link, button, field or label, so only the 6 px tile border was draggable; and the three sheets bound the two grids with `connectWith: "ul"`, so a drag could drop an own photo into the platform grid without it becoming a copy (and after a gallery refresh the classic sheets lost the binding altogether).

Now: a grip on every tile (`ba-grip`, top right, 44 px, a span because no drag starts on a button), the sortable bound at that handle per grid without `connectWith`, in one place (`vehicle.bindPhotoSorting`) rebound after every gallery refresh; the three sheets bind nothing themselves and the save address lives on the gallery (`data-reorder-url`). On a phone (touch scrolls, as with jQuery UI) there is no grip: the ⋯ sheet has "Verplaats naar voren" / "Verplaats naar achteren" rows that move the tile one place (`vehicle.movePhoto`, skipping tiles the filter hides). I chose the sheet rows over long-press: long-press collides with the system context menus and is undiscoverable. On the desktop the two rows are not in the hover overlay (four buttons is already full). Every change saves at once and says "Volgorde bewaard" (or that it failed). `change_image_order` was fine: steps of ten in the given order, foreign ids skipped, another dealer refused; the main photo is the lowest `sort_order` (`Vehicle::primary_photo`), so the first in the drag becomes the main photo, as R S1-6.3 says.

## 4. Own photos for every vehicle type

"we moeten hier ook foto's kunnen toevoegen" on a vehicle outside the own fleet: the Foto's step showed only Video's. Since PR 401 the whole own set carried `own_vehicle_only`, which `.ui-vtype-1/2` (Livewire) and `.d-none` (classic) hide. Checked against Delta's app (`41173e7a`): there the grid and the upload zone were shown for these vehicles; only the heading, the background choice and the button row carried the class. A regression, not a decision. Now only the platform-related parts carry the class: the lead under the heading, the "Enkel met achtergrond" filter, the bulk "Achtergrond verwijderen" and "Naar Stocklist kopiëren"; the platform section keeps it, the tile wand was already behind `!for_export`, the tile copy button already had the class. One deliberate difference from Delta: the bulk Verwijderen stays for these vehicles (it is not about the platform, and per tile it was already possible). The photos step has no validation rules of its own, so "Volgende" asks nothing new.

## Rules and findings

New rules R S1-6.32 (processing state and progress) and R S1-6.33 (reorder: grip, sheet rows, per-grid, saved at once). Findings, all `opgelost`: `platformkopie-melding-te-vet`, `kopieren-toonde-grijze-tegels-zonder-einde`, `fotovolgorde-slepen-werkte-niet` (ernst nu), `exportwagen-zonder-fototab` (ernst nu).

## Tests

New: `PhotoProcessingProgressTest` (the poll's JSON contract: done rows with fresh view, `queued` only without a worker, the processing to done transition, the shape of a tile in processing, the script parts that drive pill and line), `PhotoReorderTest` (contract of `change_image_order`: order, main photo, foreign ids, other dealer; id, grip and move rows on every tile of both sets; the binding in the script). Extended `PhotoTabToolbarTest` with the quiet notice and the export-vehicle tab; `PlatformPhotosOnShareTest` follows the new button label.

`PhotoTabToolbar|PhotoActionsDoNotReload|PlatformPhotosOnShare|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|BuildContract|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|PhotoProcessingProgress|PhotoReorder|PhotoGalleriesSeparate|PhotoSelectAll|ProcessImageKeepsPhoto|SettingsPhoneLayout`: OK (79 tests, 1381 assertions); `VehicleForm*|ImageEditorSave|VehicleImageRoute|ProcessImage*`: OK (29 tests).

## Screenshots

Taken against a local server with the bucket and the copy request intercepted (no bucket here, so the "before" progress shot shows the ring on photos that would be grey in production). In `.playwright-mcp/photo-warning-progress/`: `before/notice-1440.png`, `before/notice-390.png`, `before/copy-in-progress-onload-1440.png`; `after/notice-1440.png`, `after/notice-390.png`, `after/copy-request-1440.png` (own tiles dimmed, three at a time), `after/copy-queued-0-1440.png`, `after/copy-progress-3-of-6-1440.png` ("3 van 6 kopieën klaar", two "In wachtrij…", one "Kopie maken…"), `after/copy-late-1440.png`, `after/copy-done-1440.png`, `after/copy-done-settled-1440.png`, the same series at 390, `after/grip-1440.png`, `after/dragging-1440.png`, `after/dragged-saved-1440.png` (toast "Volgorde bewaard", PUT 200, order read back from the database), `after/sheet-390.png` (the two move rows), `after/moved-saved-390.png`, `after/export-1440.png`.
params.title: Photo tab: a quiet platform-copy notice and a visible copy progress
